newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Entertainment Dec sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Entertainment Dec sales rise.

text.p: Trans World Entertainment Corp said Tuesday that comparable store sales increased 4 percent for the five- week period ended January 4.

Quarter-to-date comparable store sales increased 1 percent. Total sales for the nine-week period ended January 4, 1997, were $151 million compared to $160 million during the same period last year. Total sales reflect sales from 484 stores compared to 582 stores in the same period last year.

For the eleven-month period ended January 4, 1997, comparable store sales increased 4 percent. Total sales for the eleven-month period were $452 million compared to $479 million during the same period last year.

Robert Higgins, Trans World's chairman, president, and chief executive, said, "Our quarter-to-date sales reflect the company's ability to strategically downsize its operations with minimal effect to our top line performance. With five fewer shopping days this season and lower than expected consumer traffic, overall sales declined only 6 percent despite a 20 percent decline in store locations while same store sales were positive. We remain optimistic about our year-end results and believe the company will continue to improve upon its quarterly results."
